modules.name: Durable task episodes
modules.summary: Versioned FactoryWorld records retain actual action outcomes and policy identity; interruption recovery and receipt-bound verification pass.

modules.name: Pinned Fraymus prototype learning
modules.summary: A bounded Node worker updates supervised 64-dimensional prototypes, reads back routing, deduplicates episode IDs and proposes two defined strategies.

modules.name: Adaptive live controller
modules.summary: The active policy governs the actual agent loop. A stale click becomes a fresh observation, and the learned read budget prevents a repeated read.

modules.name: Independent browser and canvas replay
modules.summary: Eight actual fixture cases compare baseline and candidate. Separate browser partitions leave the user page untouched.

modules.name: Atomic promotion and rollback
modules.summary: First policy 5/8 to 8/8; lower read budget retains 8/8; harmful candidate is rejected; parent and prototype memory restore together.

modules.name: Learning in the existing workspace
modules.summary: Project objects, contextual evidence dialog, compact controller controls and the existing bottom timeline expose real records without new placeholder pages.

modules.name: Actual local-model workflow
modules.summary: gpt-oss:20b creates, tests and saves the counter with controller v2 and a persisted verified episode. Independent Add/Reset assertions pass.

modules.name: Preserved artifact and recipe workflow
modules.summary: Versioned files, actual test receipts, reusable recipes, isolation and renderer recovery still pass the original integration checks.

modules.name: Preserved Game Lab
modules.summary: The full native game editor remains separate and its integration check still passes; learning episodes are not yet wired into its live tick stream.

modules.name: Broader tasks and model training
modules.summary: Expand independent task families, dynamic browser failures, embodied episode alignment and training workers. Full-model Ollama training is not delivered here.
